t.zh: ?A ≐ ?A → 地湿：?A 要等于一句比它自身还长的话。代入一次，右边又多出一个 ?A，永远代不完，这组等式无解。现有的元件对它都无能为力：重复框转一圈毫无变化，就此停下。新元件「出现检查」：找到 ?A ≐ t 而 t 中含有 ?A 的等式，宣布失败。
t.en: ?A ≐ ?A → the ground is wet: ?A must equal a sentence longer than itself. Put in once, the right side gains another ?A, and it never ends: there is no solution. None of the parts so far can do anything with it; the repeat frame goes round once, nothing changes, and it stops. A new part, “Occurs check”, finds ?A ≐ t with ?A inside t, and declares failure.

after.zh: 许多合一程序为了速度省掉出现检查，Prolog 默认也不做；代价是可能「证」出假话。
after.en: Many unifiers leave the occurs check out for speed, Prolog among them by default; the price is that something false may be “proved”.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：把每组等式解到底；没有解的，说「失败」。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that solves each set of equations to the end, or says “failed” when there is no solution.

hint.zh: 重复框停下时，剩下的等式真的解完了吗？
hint.en: When the frame stops, are the equations left really solved?
